arguments.sql: SELECT m.id AS merchant_id, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id GROUP BY m.id ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, m.id ASC LIMIT 5
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions per merchant id and returns the five merchants with the most, highest first.
assumptions: All transactions are counted, labelled or not, including those with negative amounts and those with errors.
Ties in count are broken by lower merchant id.
